description: This file is a C source test file related to libcurl, containing test functions, callback implementations, debug functions, and example code for performing HTTP POST requests with custom callbacks.

methods.name: void dump(const char * text,FILE * stream,unsigned char * ptr,size_t size,char nohex)
methods.description: A utility function to display memory content in hex and ASCII format, with optional nohex display.

methods.name: int my_trace(CURL * handle,curl_infotype type,char * data,size_t size,void * userp)
methods.description: A debug callback function to trace and output network data, headers, and info from curl operations.

methods.name: size_t read_callback(char * ptr,size_t size,size_t nmemb,void * stream)
methods.description: A callback to supply data to curl during a POST operation, reading from a buffer.

methods.name: size_t write_callback(void * ptr,size_t size,size_t nmemb,void * stream)
methods.description: A callback to handle data received during curl operations, printing it to stdout.

methods.name: curlioerr ioctl_callback(CURL * handle,int cmd,void * clientp)
methods.description: A callback to handle IO control commands from curl, such as restarting the read operation.

methods.name: CURLcode test(char * URL)
methods.description: The main test function that initializes curl, sets options, performs a POST request, and cleans up.

ctags.signature: (const char * text,FILE * stream,unsigned char * ptr,size_t size,char nohex)
